name: duopore-public-application-next-actions
description: See which job applications need your next action, so you can plan follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: See which job applications need your next action, so you can plan follow-ups. Share application stages, contact dates and your chosen follow-up interval. Get a dated queue, with late events and closed applications marked. For adults planning their own job search. Follow-up timing is your own rule; the app does not contact employers or keep a saved tracker.
defaultPrompt: Which of my job applications needs a follow-up next?
Make a next-action list from these application dates and stages.
